# discord_current_user (Data Source)

Reads the Discord user associated with the configured token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_current_user" "this" {}

output "bot_username" {
  value = data.discord_current_user.this.username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String) The user's avatar hash.
- `bot` (Boolean) Whether the user is a bot.
- `discriminator` (String) The user's legacy discriminator.
- `global_name` (String) The user's display (global) name.
- `id` (String) User snowflake ID.
- `username` (String) The user's username.
